main_text.head: MANVSCRIPTVM POSTERIVS, HOC EST, EXAMEN

p.i: Tractatus singularis, De peccato originis, In quo demonstratur primum primi hominis peccatum omnibus hominibus imputari, oppositi Thesibus de statu hominis lapsi ante gratiam, disputatis Salmurij die 16. Martij An. 1640. sub Præsidio Josue Placei S.Theologiæ Professoris in Academia Salmuriensi.

main_text.head: CAPVT I.
Capita doctrinæ de Peccato originali de quibus inter nos conuenit.
main_text.p: LICEAT mihi, quæso, Vir reuerende, te, perinde ac si coram sermone res ageretur, compellare & alloqui : Sic enim, vti spero, tua, velut oculis meis obuersantis præsentia me torpentem excitabit, & ad tui majorem reuerentiam componet.
Tu quidem pro tua singulari prudentia voluisti tibi

page.notes: The initial letter is a large woodcut "I" (rendered as "L" in the printed form of the first word, read here as LICEAT). The first word of the body is printed with the woodcut initial; the letter is partly obscured by the ornament. The title block is set in italic and roman capitals as printed.
